D: Five years after half of all life vanished, the surviving Avengers try one last plan to bring everyone back.
P: Serve the cheeseburgers when Happy promises Morgan all the cheeseburgers she wants.
S: Tony's quiet cabin by the lake with Morgan

Soft bread rolls filled with poached chicken, mayo, celery, chives and lemon, with crisp lettuce, packed in a basket with apple slices and strawberries. Poach 2 chicken breasts in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, cool and shred. Mix with 5 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 finely diced celery sticks, chopped chives, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper. Split 8 soft dinner rolls, butter them and fill with lettuce and chicken salad. Pack into a basket with sliced apple tossed in lemon and a punnet of strawberries.
Thor in New Asgard with his beer and video games

Baked potato skins scooped and crisped, filled with cheddar and crispy bacon, finished with sour cream, spring onion and a hit of hot sauce. Bake 6 medium potatoes at 200C for 1 hour. Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins inside and out with oil and salt. Bake cut side down for 10 minutes, then turn over. Fry 6 rashers bacon until crisp and chop. Fill the skins with 200g grated cheddar and bacon and bake 8 minutes until bubbling. Top with sour cream, sliced spring onion and a few drops of hot sauce.
Scott back at the compound, eating a taco
Hard shell tacos with spiced beef mince, lettuce, cheddar and salsa, a few laid out on a plate for whoever wanders in.
M: Happy promises her as many as she wants
Chuck mince smashed thin on a smoking griddle, American cheese melted on, pickles, onion, tomato sauce and mustard on soft toasted buns, double stacked. Crinkle fries.
the time heist to the army base in 1970

A 1970 mess hall meatloaf of beef and pork with a sticky tomato glaze, sliced thick with mashed potato, buttered peas and onion gravy. Soak 60g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk. Mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and salt. Shape on a lined tray. Mix 100ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar, brush half over and bake at 180C for 50 minutes, adding the rest halfway. Serve with mash, buttered peas and gravy from 1 sliced onion, 300ml beef stock and 1 tbsp cornflour.
W: Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes, layered with fudge frosting and piped on top with 3000 in red and gold.
K: Tony and Morgan and the juice pops at the lake house

Frozen orange, mango and passionfruit juice blended into icy slushies, served in tall cups with a splash of vodka for the grown-ups if you want it. Freeze 500ml orange juice in ice cube trays overnight. Blend the juice cubes with 1 chopped mango, the pulp of 3 passionfruit, 200ml cold apple juice and 1 tbsp honey until slushy. Pour into tall cups with a straw. Stir 30ml vodka into any adult cups if you like.

s.how: Brown 500g beef mince with 1 tsp cumin and taco spices. Fill 12 hard taco shells with the beef, shredded lettuce, 100g grated cheddar and diced tomato. Lay them out for whoever wanders in.

m.note: Happy promises her as many as she wants
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g chuck mince on a smoking griddle and add American cheese. Stack two per soft toasted bun with pickles, onion, tomato sauce and mustard. Fry 1kg crinkle-cut potatoes twice.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter, whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Layer with fudge frosting of 300g icing sugar, cocoa and butter. Pipe 3000 on top in red.
